posts.zh:
dsh-restart-button 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-603ea828514a5030fc3f.html
posts.en:
dsh-restart-button is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-603ea828514a5030fc3f.html
